    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games they want to play" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Date proposal" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Date responses" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitations" name="Invitations"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of games guests want to play"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateProposal" name="Proposed LAN party date"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateResponses" name="Responses about availability for the date"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_LANParty">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Organizer" name="Organizer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_PlanParty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiveGameList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FindDateAndCheckGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AppointDate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDateProposal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiveDateResponses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EnoughFriendsAgree</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRequestedGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllRequestedGamesAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DownloadMissingGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GamesReadyMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DateAndGamesReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindRequiredBeer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EnoughBeer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyMissingBeer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BeerReadyMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnjoyLANParty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanParty" name="Plan LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive the list of games guests want to play">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FindDateAndCheckGames" name="Find a date and check requested games"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date for the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDateProposal" name="Send the proposed date to the friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" name="Receive responses about who is free to join on the date">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EnoughFriendsAgree" name="Do 8 or more friends agree on the date?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequestedGames" name="Check whether all games guests want to play are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllRequestedGamesAvailable" name="Are all requested games available?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadMissingGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesReadyMerge" name="Continue after requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DateAndGamesReady" name="Date is set and requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindRequiredBeer" name="Find out how much beer the friends require"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EnoughBeer" name="Is there enough beer for the friends?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyMissingBeer" name="Buy the missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerReadyMerge" name="Continue when enough beer is available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanParty" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Event_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_FindDateAndGames" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_FindDateAndCheckGames"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_FindDateAndCheckGames" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_SendDateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveResponses" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Responses_DateDecision" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" targetRef="Gateway_EnoughFriendsAgree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAccepted" name="8 or more friends agree" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFriendsAgree" targetRef="Gateway_DateAndGamesReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">agreeingFriendCount >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateRetry" name="Fewer than 8 friends agree; appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFriendsAgree" targetRef="Task_AppointDate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">agreeingFriendCount < 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_FindDateAndCheckGames" targetRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_AvailabilityDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames" targetRef="Gateway_AllRequestedGamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="All requested games are available" sourceRef="Gateway_AllRequestedGamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesReadyMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequestedGamesAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some requested games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_AllRequestedGamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someRequestedGamesAreMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadGames_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_DateAndGamesReady" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesReadyMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DateAndGamesReady"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAndGamesReady_FindBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAndGamesReady" targetRef="Task_FindRequiredBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FindBeer_BeerDecision" sourceRef="Task_FindRequiredBeer" targetRef="Gateway_EnoughBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerReadyMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeerQuantity >= requiredBeerQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughBeer" targetRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeerQuantity < requiredBeerQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_EnjoyParty" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerReadyMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyParty_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitations"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games guests want to play" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Proposed LAN party date" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Responses about availability for the date" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
